title: Kizuki Wave 1: spine (contracts, ledger, vault, staging, promote, CLI, e2e stranger loop)
description: Historical scope. `promote` in this title is the leftover Wave 1 verb, not the product gate: canon is written by the receipted writer, with no owner review queue and no owner approval step (docs/decision-log.md D9, D10; rfcs/0002-autonomous-canon.md).
closeReason: Wave 1 spine merged on main (contracts, ledger, vault, staging, connectors, CLI, TUI); 515 tests green at 76930db

title: Kizuki Wave 2: serving (MCP server, agent grants+audit, FTS, context packets)
description: Serving exposes two write tools, `propose` and `correct`; neither files anything for a person to approve (docs/decision-log.md D14). Read docs/CURRENT.md, docs/decision-log.md and rfcs/0002-autonomous-canon.md first.

title: Kizuki Wave 3: connector waves (email/calendar, Telegram/Gmail/X, WhatsApp/WHOOP/Screenpipe/Composio) conformance-gated
description: Connector manifests declare `default_sensitivity` and `sensitivity_floor`; sensitivity is auto-assigned upward-only and defaults to private, never labeled by the owner (docs/decision-log.md D11; rfcs/0002-autonomous-canon.md §8).

title: Kizuki Wave 4: proactive rails (serve daemon, scheduler receipts, daily brief, notifiers)
description: `kizuki init` installs `kizuki serve` as an always-on user service; a unit that is absent, disabled or masked is a doctor failure. The daemon's loop writes canon under a per-run and per-day budget, receipted and reversible (docs/decision-log.md D9, D15).

title: Kizuki Wave 5: hardening + first public visibility (SECURITY.md, RFC absorption, packaging, stranger proof)
description: The stranger proof drives the loop writing canon under a receipt, then `tell` and `undo`; `review` / `promote` / `reject` are not the owner path (docs/decision-log.md D9, D10). The moat claim is autonomy with total provenance and reversibility, not a review gate (C8).

title: Kizuki Wave 6: estate migration (importer, parallel run, MCP re-point, cutover)
description: Migration lands evidence and lets the loop write canon under receipts. There are no owner review batches and no owner labeling of sensitivity (docs/decision-log.md D10, D11). The 14-day parallel run is shadow mode with a stop-and-report at day 7 (C7).
